data.best_text: March to April and October to November. The swimming season is November to March.
data.day_budget_note: Per person per day excluding flights: a share of a mid-range double room, food, local transport and one sight. A rough estimate.

stay.label: Four days
stay.text: The harbour, the Opera House, Manly and the coastal walk.

stay.label: One week
stay.text: Time for a day trip to the Blue Mountains and more beaches.

stay.label: Ten days
stay.text: Add the coast north or south of the city.

areas.name: CBD and The Rocks
areas.text: Walking distance to Circular Quay, the ferries and the Opera House.

areas.name: Surry Hills
areas.text: Cafés and restaurants, close to Central where the airport train stops.

areas.name: Bondi
areas.text: Beach life and the coastal walk on your doorstep. Bus and train into the city.

areas.name: Manly
areas.text: A beach and a small-town feel, 30 minutes by ferry from the city.

areas.name: Kings Cross
areas.text: The city's old nightlife district. Cheap, but rowdier at night.

transport.text: 13 minutes to Central. Tap your payment card at the gate. A station fee is added to the fare.
The ferry to Manly takes 30 minutes and passes the Opera House.

events.name: New Year's Eve fireworks
events.text: Fireworks over the harbour and the bridge. Good spots fill up early in the day.

events.name: Sydney Festival
events.text: Three weeks of theatre, music and free outdoor events.

events.name: Sydney Mardi Gras
events.text: Pride festival that ends with the parade on Oxford Street.

events.name: Vivid Sydney
events.text: Festival of light by the harbour and the Opera House, 23 nights. Free.

seasons.name: Whales along the coast
seasons.text: Humpback whales pass by on their migration.

month_notes: High summer and beach weather, but school holidays and high prices.
Warm sea and slightly fewer tourists than in January.
Late summer: still beach weather and quieter.
Mild and clear. Good for the coastal walk.
Autumn. Cooler evenings and more rain.
Winter in the southern hemisphere: cool and too cold for swimming.
The coldest month of the year, but rarely below ten degrees.
Still winter. The cheapest time to stay.
Spring. Warmer days and few tourists.
The swimming season begins and prices are still reasonable.
Summer, Christmas and New Year's Eve fireworks. Expensive and fully booked towards the end.

prices.summary: More expensive than at home, above all beer and dinner at a restaurant.
tips: Another source gives higher prices: 135 dollars for a three-course meal for two, 11 for a beer and 5.60 for a cappuccino.

AU-fakta-betala.title: Currency: Australian dollar (AUD)
AU-fakta-betala.summary: The country uses the Australian dollar (AUD).

AU-fakta-mobil.title: EU roaming does not apply
AU-fakta-mobil.summary: Australia is outside the EU's roaming rules.
AU-fakta-mobil.body: Operators can charge entirely different prices outside the EU. Check the price list or buy a local data package or eSIM before you turn on mobile data.

AU-fakta-inresa.title: A free eVisitor is required before the trip
AU-fakta-inresa.summary: Swedish citizens apply for an eVisitor (651) online. It costs nothing.
AU-fakta-inresa.body: The permit is valid for twelve months and lets you stay up to three months per visit. You apply in ImmiAccount in a web browser, not in the ETA app. It cannot be extended.

AU-fakta-biosakerhet.title: Declare all food, plants and animal products
AU-fakta-biosakerhet.summary: Tick yes on the incoming passenger card if you have food, seeds, wood or animal products with you.
AU-fakta-biosakerhet.body: Fines for undeclared goods were between 550 and 5,500 Australian dollars in 2023. Answer every question truthfully. An officer may inspect what you declare.

AU-fakta-dricks.title: Tipping is not needed
AU-fakta-dricks.summary: Tipping is not necessary in restaurants, but it is becoming more common.
AU-fakta-dricks.body: Staff are paid wages that do not depend on tips.

AU-sydney-fakta-ta-sig-dit.title: The airport train takes 13 minutes but has an extra fee
AU-sydney-fakta-ta-sig-dit.summary: The stations at the airport charge 17.92 dollars extra per adult on top of the train fare.
AU-sydney-fakta-ta-sig-dit.body: The fee is deducted automatically when you tap an Opal card or an ordinary payment card. If you buy a single ticket the fee is slightly higher. Anyone topping up an Opal card at the airport must load at least 35 dollars.

AU-fakta-alkohol.title: Alcohol from age 18
AU-fakta-alkohol.summary: The age limit is 18 throughout the country, both to buy and to drink in bars.
AU-fakta-alkohol.body: A passport is accepted as ID. Bring it if you look young.

AU-sydney-operahuset.name: The Opera House
AU-sydney-operahuset.summary: A World Heritage Site by the harbour. Guided tours take about an hour.
AU-sydney-operahuset.body: The building is at Circular Quay, served by trains and ferries.

AU-sydney-bondi-coogee.name: The Bondi to Coogee coastal walk
AU-sydney-bondi-coogee.summary: Six kilometres along the cliffs past five beaches. Free.
AU-sydney-bondi-coogee.body: The trail is signposted all the way and takes 2–3 hours. It goes via Tamarama, Bronte and Clovelly. There are stairs, so it does not work with a wheelchair or pram. Take public transport to Bondi, parking is difficult at weekends.

AU-sydney-manlyfarjan.name: The ferry to Manly
AU-sydney-manlyfarjan.summary: 30 minutes across the harbour from Circular Quay.
AU-sydney-manlyfarjan.body: You see the Opera House and the bridge from the water on the way out.

daggdjur-kanguru.name: Kangaroo
daggdjur-kanguru.hint: Easiest to see at dawn and dusk outside the cities.

daggdjur-koala.name: Koala
daggdjur-koala.hint: Sleeps in eucalyptus trees for most of the day.

fagel-kakadua.name: Sulphur-crested cockatoo
fagel-kakadua.hint: A large white parrot you hear long before you see it.

dryck-flat-white.name: Flat white
dryck-flat-white.hint: Espresso with steamed milk and a thin layer of foam.

bakverk-lamington.name: Lamington
bakverk-lamington.hint: A square of sponge cake dipped in chocolate and coconut.

AU-sydney-ide-kustvandring.title: Bondi to Coogee with a swim stop
AU-sydney-ide-kustvandring.body: Start in Bondi in the morning, swim at Bronte halfway and have lunch in Coogee.

AU-sydney-ide-manly.title: Ferry to Manly at sunset
AU-sydney-ide-manly.body: Head out in the afternoon and take the ferry back as the sun sets behind the bridge.

AU-present-mugg.name: Mug with Aboriginal art
AU-present-mugg.body: Choose one where the artist is named and gets paid.

AU-present-kex.name: Chocolate biscuits
AU-present-kex.body: Australia's best-known biscuits, sold in every supermarket.
